notes.title: Patch 1.1.28 - French language added
notes.notes: Ungate now supports the French language! Explore the terrifying world of Ungate in French and immerse yourself even deeper into the experience. Thank you for your support !

notes.title: Update - New language added !
notes.notes:
Ungate now fully supports the German language and is ready to be played by players in Germany! The game has been polished to perfection and is prepared to offer you a unique and powerful experience.

For those who didn't join the experience yet, prepare to embark on a unique journey filled with challenges, stunning visuals, and captivating gameplay that will keep you engaged!

I invite you to play the game and challenge your friends to join in!

notes.title: IMPORTANT GAMEPLAY UPDATE
notes.notes:
Gameplay Update

1. At level 1 (surface), a few adjustments and improvements have been made to the gameplay experience.
2. At level 2 (basement), you can now run freely like on the surface without being blocked by monsters, improving the fluidity of the gameplay and increasing your chances of finishing the game faster. At the same time, additional hints have been added.

These gameplay changes aim to enhance the overall game experience, taking into account players' feedback and suggestions. 
I hope you'll enjoy the changes, and happy gaming!

If you made a video and posted it on the internet, be sure I've seen it at least once XD

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
The game now offers 2 difficulty options to choose from: Survivor and Explorer, as well as 2 language options: English and Romanian. Additionally, a Brightness option has been added, along with several upgrades to the UX/UI interface;

Once again, the game should be treated as a challenge, therefore I challenge you to finish the game; next, you should challenge your friends to finish the game and so on !

Here are the rules for each difficulty: 

EXPLORER DIFFICULTY RULES: 

1. There's no savegame, once you exit the game you will start from the beginning
2. After finishing the cabin's objectives you'll unlock 1 respawn zone with unlimited lives and the progress will be kept
3. If you die before unlocking your unlimited lives you'll start from the beginning
4. The game has 3 levels and if you get to a respawn zone and unlock it, you'll respawn at that location
5. If you die, you will respawn at the last unlocked respawn zone you walked on
6. Using crouch can make you silent and also recover your stamina faster
7. You can use your journal to check the gathered clues
8. The game becomes really intense along the way and also the difficulty increases
9. Only bravery, vigilence, curiosity and attention to details will get you to the end

SURVIVOR DIFFICULTY RULES: 

1. There's no savegame, once you exit the game or die 3 times after you unlock your 3 lives, you will start from the beginning
2. If you die before unlocking your 3 lives you'll start from the beginning
3. The game has 3 levels and if you get to a respawn zone and activate it, you'll unlock your 3 lives per level
4. If you die, you will respawn at the last activated respawn zone you walked on, up to 3 times and the progress will be kept
5. Using crouch can make you silent and also recover your stamina faster
6. You can use your journal to check the gathered clues
7. The game becomes really intense along the way and also the difficulty increases
8. Only bravery, vigilence, curiosity and attention to details will get you to the end
